tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Genko Prior Auth's public site: docs, prior authorization guides, specialty pages (dental, aesthetics, physiotherapy), pricing, facts and agent information. Returns up to 10 ranked pages with URL and snippet; read one in full with get_page. Public content only, no practice or patient data.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one public Genko Prior Auth page as Markdown (the same text as its .md version), by path or URL, e.g. '/pricing', '/facts', '/docs/faq'. Public pages only; the signed-in app is never available.

tools.name: get_packet_checklist
tools.description: What Genko Prior Auth collects for a prior authorization request in a specialty (dental, aesthetics, physiotherapy, or the generic form): request details, structured-findings fields and choices, and code systems. Useful for 'what goes in a packet'. No patient data, no code descriptors.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Checked facts about Genko Prior Auth: what it is and isn't, who it's for, stage, specialties, how payers are handled, security, limits, pricing and what exists for agents. Same source as /facts and /facts.json. Quote these instead of guessing.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current Genko Prior Auth plans in US dollars per practice per month, with each plan's monthly draft and AI-token limits and the free trial's terms. Use this to answer 'how much does it cost'; never estimate prices.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Say whether Genko Prior Auth supports a practice's specialty (own form, general form, or not supported) and what it offers there, from what the product implements. A payer can be given, but the product does not evaluate payers or payer rules, and the answer says so.

findings.detail: Description of "search_docs" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
